full_page.content:
1935, August
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 23 Aug. 1
Louis P. Gardiner - 27 - out of work was planing on marriage but ....
2 Robert Mckeever - 3 - cancerous tuomer on kidney - given up by Drs. last night when enrolled by phone. Father of Child here To-night reports decided improvement - Smiled To-day first time in long time and asked for something to Eat. Deo Gr. Aug. 4 Same R. McK. came to curb-stone - Aug. 8 Mother phones "Boy doing fine ... "
3 Theodore Bellfy - 40 - heart clot Drs. have very little hope. En- rolled To-day 50c ... promising perpt. if
Eva Kelly - 36 - nerve trouble ...
4 Dr. J. Cunningham Dr. Reed - middle age - non Cath. - unfortunate marriage
Page 24 Aug. Minnie Heffernan - 58 - threatend with gland operation in week ...
Oscar Labadie - 37 - Engaged to marry next month to a party not yet Catholic but started with instructions. Now comes threatening diffi- culties.
Samuel Dawney - 35 - nervous trouble. Has wife and four small child- ren ... had been drinking but "cut it out with pledge".
Mrs. Kirby - 89 - Rev. Fr. K's Mother - Slight Stroke - Husband 90- Jubilee next yr ....
Page 25 Aug. 7 Maurice Ryall - 27 - Methodist (?) lost eye August 9th, '29 - 7 days unconscious, believes he was just next to insane. Has doctored and doctored - almost hopeless came To-day to Monastery.
Mrs. Josephine Mohr - 8 sight trouble ... Andrew Sullivan - 54 - stomach cancer Frank J. Joffernan - 77
Page 26 Aug. 7 Sister Marg. of Pambrook near Ottowa - hearing very defective.
